reason: CPU Core latency differs from the historical H100 mean. Add per-pair matched latency so fixed 0.16-second references cannot be mistaken for an equal-time comparison.
declared_after: The first 38 native CPU pairs had partial outputs; no matched-budget classical results had been run.
budget_rule: Arithmetic mean of the three measured ENPDA-Core seed latencies for this same pair, host, and device, including validation.
scope: All 291 native and all 100 preselected natural pairs, without outcome filtering.
timing: Cooperative cap; retain measured end-to-end latency and overshoot. No strict deadline or exact-objective-equivalence claim.
